summary: A custom slot supplier in the Go SDK cannot determine if a task queue is sticky when reserving slots. The request is to expose task queue stickiness to the slot supplier interface to align with other Temporal SDKs.
userImpact: Users implementing custom slot suppliers in the Go SDK cannot access task queue stickiness information needed for intelligent slot reservation decisions.
proposedFix: Expose task queue stickiness information to the SlotSupplier interface or API.
keyQuote: A custom slot supplier cannot determine if a TQ is sticky when reserving slots
